task: T1: rename the strategy files and teach run-loop.sh the new extension, IN ONE TASK. Rename all five files under scripts/loops/ from `<name>.env` to `<name>.conf` with `git mv`, leaving scripts/loops/README.md alone — it documents the contract and is not a strategy. In the same task update the three places scripts/run-loop.sh depends on the old extension: the `--list` glob near line 17 that enumerates `"$LOOPS_DIR"/*.env`, the `basename "$f" .env` on the next line that strips it for display, and the resolution `ENV_FILE="$LOOPS_DIR/$STRATEGY.env"` near line 28. Also correct the header comment near line 7 that states the contract in prose as `scripts/loops/<name>.env`. These halves MUST land together: rename alone and the next invocation looks for `<name>.conf` beside files still called `.env`; edit alone and it looks for files that do not exist yet. Either intermediate state leaves the loop unable to start, which is exactly the state a failed attempt leaves behind. Do NOT keep a fallback that accepts `.env` as well — five files in one repo change in one commit, and a dual-path resolver would outlive the migration and keep the old name alive. This task edits the script the loop is executing, so expect a nonzero exit afterwards: run `bash -n` on it before treating that as a defect, and re-invoke the loop rather than resuming it.
